paths.name: framer-motion
paths.message: Import from "motion/react" instead. `motion` v12 re-exports the same API and already depends on framer-motion@12; importing the bare package pulled in a SECOND copy of the animation engine and shipped both — 34 kB gzipped on the homepage alone. Only one of the two names may appear in this repo.

patterns.message: The tools platform must never touch the database. Every /tools route is statically generated at build time, and the shared Mongo pool uses minPoolSize: 5 — a single warm lambda pins five Atlas connections. Tool data lives in src/lib/tools/registry.ts, which is an in-memory array. If a tool genuinely needs persistence, it needs its own pool (minPoolSize: 0) and its own route outside (tools).

cn() is clsx + tailwind-merge, and tailwind-merge alone is ~21 kB of client JavaScript on a route whose entire purpose is search performance. Use cx() from @/components/tools/ui instead — see the rationale at the top of that file.
